Dataset Card for ImgMT: Wikipedia-based Dataset For Evaluating Text-in-Image Translation
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Summary
	

The ImgMT dataset is a multilingual multimodal benchmark consisting of infographics, maps, scientific diagrams, and educational illustrations collected from Wikimedia Commons. In this dataset, visually identical vector graphics differ exclusively in the language of the embedded textual labels.
